Officer's narrative
Officers were dispatched to an intersection in Houston, Texas, where a vehicle operated by Driver 1 was struck after
turning left across the path of Driver 2's vehicle. Driver 1 is the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle.
Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle and was present at the scene, a fact
confirmed by both drivers and by independent witnesses. Passenger told officres that the impact therw Passenger
against the door frame and that a wrist was injured, and the nature of that injury is consistent with the force of a
broadside collision of this kind. Driver 2 gave a statement that matches the account provided by Driver 1, and two
witnesses who were nearby described the sequence in the same way. Photographs taken at the scene show damage
to the left side of Driver 1's vehicle and to the front of Driver 2's vehicle, and that damage lines up with the impact
described. Nothing in the vehicle or in the statements indicated any prior damage to the vehicle in the area that was
struck.
